summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Bill Farr photography site. All 8 pytest backend tests passed (POST/GET /api/inquiries success paths, validation 422 for bad email / missing / empty fields, list sort order, no _id leakage). Playwright frontend tests all passed: hero image + headline 'Where the light still runs wild.', navbar with all required data-testids incl. Book a shoot, smooth scroll on nav clicks, Western + Travel lightbox open/next/prev/close, Prints 'Inquire to purchase' correctly scrolls to contact and prefills subject with print title + selects inquiry_type=print, contact form empty-submit error toast, successful submit produces success toast, clears form, and inquiry is persisted (verified via GET /api/inquiries). No 'Made with Emergent' badge present in the DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: logger is used inside create_inquiry() (line 66) but defined below on line 90. Works at runtime because module-level code completes before requests are served, but for clarity and to avoid future refactor breakage, initialise `logger` BEFORE defining routes.
backend/server.py: `@app.on_event('shutdown')` is deprecated in FastAPI — prefer the `lifespan` context manager.
backend/server.py: no rate limiting or basic anti-spam on public POST /api/inquiries — recommend simple IP throttling or CAPTCHA if this endpoint is publicly exposed.
backend/server.py: GET /api/inquiries returns all rows unpaginated (limit 1000). Add pagination (skip/limit query params) for future growth.
Contact.jsx: on network failure the bare `catch` swallows the error; consider logging the error object for diagnostics.
Prints.jsx / WesternGallery.jsx: gallery `img` tags have no lazy-loading (`loading="lazy"`) — could hurt initial load if the gallery grows.

Lightbox close-on-backdrop-click works, but the surrounding <motion.figure> uses stopPropagation — fine; consider also closing on ESC only when a single lightbox instance is open (works today because two galleries each own state).
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed inquiries in MongoDB via POST /api/inquiries during testing; safe to leave (used unique UUID emails).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints: GET /api/, POST /api/inquiries, GET /api/inquiries. All validated. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py runs in ~2s. Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll (window.__lenis.scrollTo). All interactive elements have kebab-case data-testids as documented in the review request. No Emergent badge.
